semantic_adoption_after_blind_seal.comparison_minimum_reason: At least half of the 20 distinct held-out groups must support the complete within-QA comparison. This is a feasibility threshold, not power, effect size or significance; keep every selected QA and do not refill.

resource_policy.token_limits: Preserve the adopted per-task input/output reservations; never truncate or drop fixed units. Total token ceilings follow the finite call ceiling and largest adopted per-call reservation.
resource_policy.time_limits: Preserve adopted per-call timeout; record measured step seconds and estimate total time from both complete main runs. No total wall-clock guarantee is asserted.

revision_policy: Keep all failed/stopped/unattempted QA. Do not tune on held-out outputs, extend budgets after inspecting F/Y, refill failures or reuse these groups as unused. An unsuccessful calibration cannot freeze Gate11; preserve it and separately decide any research-scope change.
sample_size_policy: 20 per language is held-out feasibility and cost validation. Final Evaluation N is decided separately using resource/precision rationale; no significance, nonzero sensitivity or quality gain is required.
